groundTruthSource.note: Reviewed at this commit: line 40 of docs/cloud/cloudflare/cf_workers.tf reads `tags = ["${var.project}", "${var.env}", "spa-fallback"]`. Interpolation-only strings are deprecated. Terraform v0.12.14 deprecated a string whose whole value is one interpolation, such as "${var.name}": the same value is written as the bare expression var.name. Terraform still accepts the quoted form but recommends the bare expression for readability, and terraform fmt repairs simple examples. A string that mixes text with an interpolation, such as "prefix-${var.name}", is not the deprecated form and still needs its quotes. Source: https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform/releases/tag/v0.12.14. The pinned file was re-fetched at the recorded commit and the cited line matches. Outcome: confirmed.
